title: A line with no description joins the title straight to the tech story
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A06 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A06 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod"), no Description and the tech story (for example "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Click an empty cell, type =LEN( then click that ItemDescription cell, type ) and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the cell reads the title, one " - ", then the tech story (with the example values "Replace tie rod - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned"): one separator, not two, and no gap where the description would have been.
  • Step 7: with the example values the number is 60 (15 characters of title + 3 for " - " + 42 of tech story = 60).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-E1, S3-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (Awkward inputs), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-008; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E1: “A line with a title, no description and a narrative reads "Replace tie rod - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned": one separator, not two, and no gap where the description would have been.”
  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a line with a title and a narrative but no description, then the text reads "Replace tie rod - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned": one separator, not two.”
